Your #1 risk (levered silver + miners) is still the pain point — silver keeps trading as a rate/industrial asset, not a haven, and it fell DURING a war. Sentiment deepened to Fear (CNN F&G 40, from 43; crypto 25).

regime.label: Hawkish hold meets an oil-shock war
regime.oneLiner: June CPI resolved soft (disinflation), but an escalating US-Iran war spiked oil ~13% and re-armed the Fed's hike tail — so metals and long-duration stay pressured while energy and defensives lead, and an AI-capex unwind rotates money out of semis into cyclicals; the 28-29 July FOMC is the next binary.

topNews.headline: Silver closes Friday at 8-month lows (~$55.60) — still can't crack $60, ~54% below January's record
topNews.actionable: The book's highest-beta pain point — keep leverage sized so the break to 8-month lows can't force liquidation, and let the oil-inflation impulse and July FOMC clear before any deep-value re-entry ($58-60 is the level to reclaim).

topNews.headline: Gold steadies right at $4,000 (~$4,017, +1% Friday) as the PBoC buys a 20th straight month
topNews.actionable: Central-bank demand is a genuine floor near ~$4,000 for the GDX/miner sleeve, but don't expect gold to rescue silver — both hinge on the oil-inflation impulse and the 28-29 July FOMC.

topNews.headline: US-Iran war keeps oil bid (WTI ~$82.5, Brent ~$88); energy is the leading S&P sector
topNews.actionable: The war premium lifts energy but is precisely what's crushing the metals book and pressuring SGX REITs — do NOT add levered silver on the spike; a Hormuz ceasefire is the fast-reversal risk both ways.

topNews.headline: Semis rout persists: SOX -11% mo, SMH -9% in 4wks on AI-capex-peak fears; money rotates to cyclicals
topNews.actionable: Don't catch the semis knife (SMH/SMIC 0981.HK); the silver lining is the rotation is INTO energy/financials/industrials, with ex-tech breadth healthy at ~69% >200-DMA.

topNews.headline: STI hits a record ~5,561; DBS first SGX stock past S$200bn; HK tech's best week in 14 months
topNews.actionable: SGX + HK-tech sleeves are the book's bright spot; with SG banks extended ~2.2x book into ~6 Aug results, favor S-REITs on lower-SORA relief and hold Tencent on its buyback bid.

signals: Model's cleanest edges stay flipped with the tape: energy XLE screens constructive near-term (pUp1m 0.55) on the war premium while semis SMH turned sub-coin-flip (pUp1m 0.48) as the AI-capex trade unwinds — consider energy as the momentum hedge, phase into semis rather than chase.

Silver (SLV) sits sub-coin-flip 1m (pUp1m 0.47, low confidence) after the crash to 8-month lows — the model won't take a directional silver bet into the oil-shock/FOMC window; 12m mean-reversion optionality is building, but let the tape base first.
Defensive-quality still screens best for equity: XLV (health care) pUp3m 0.62 and XLF (financials) pUp3m 0.60 lead — consistent with the rotation out of tech into cyclicals/defensives.

HYG (high-yield credit) pUp3m 0.40 stays the model's clearest caution — but HY OAS is still tight (~269bp), so credit is NOT yet corroborating the equity fear; watch for spread widening if the oil-inflation tail hardens.

Smart-money watch: the Q1 13Fs show a rare Alphabet split (Berkshire tripled GOOGL vs Ackman/Druckenmiller exiting) and AMZN as the broadest consensus long that Berkshire nonetheless exited — respect for direction, not for chasing at the top; Lynas's US floor-price support keeps the ex-China rare-earth thesis building (watch REMX/MP/LYC.AX pullbacks).

US-Iran war / Hormuz headlines — the dominant near-term driver; a ceasefire deflates oil (metals-positive), further escalation extends the oil-inflation squeeze
